title: dryopteris geropogon
intro: Dryopteris geropogon, commonly known as Male fern, is a species of fern that belongs to the Dryopteris genus. This plant has been traditionally used in medicine for its health benefits, which include treating parasitic worm infections, such as tapeworms and roundworms, as well as other digestive issues. The therapeutic actions of Male fern include anthelmintic, anti-inflammatory, and antiseptic properties, making it effective in treating a range of health conditions. The bioactive constituents of Male fern include sesquiterpene lactones, flavonoids, and phenolic compounds, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
